sources.institution: All USG institutions, TCSG technical colleges, Georgia Military College, state agencies and local school boards
sources.system: Open Georgia (Georgia Department of Audits and Accounts) - Salary & Travel
sources.coverage_years: FY2015-FY2025 downloadable (state fiscal year Jul-Jun); older years in search tool / DOAA CD-ROM archive back to ~2003
sources.institutions_covered: Every University System of Georgia unit, every TCSG technical college, Georgia Military College (per Open Georgia description page), plus all state agencies and K-12 boards
sources.employees: all (anyone paid in the fiscal year, incl. part-time)
sources.size: 2025 zip ~10 MB (2024 zip 9,197,715 bytes); all-years zip 111,573,331 bytes
sources.terms: Files 'made available for download and should be used at your own risk'; no other license stated
sources.notes: Verified header via partial range request: NAME,TITLE,SALARY,TRAVEL,ORGANIZATION,FISCAL_YEAR. Numbers wrapped in single quotes (strip on load). No department, no base/other pay split, no FTE/hire date. Names are LAST,FIRST M. Filter ORGANIZATION for university/college names. Per AJC reporting, foundation-paid supplements (e.g. coaches) are not included. robots.txt allows /export/ but disallows the /sta/ search app.

sources.blocker: Disclaimer click-through and search form; robots.txt disallows /sta/; redundant with bulk ZIPs.

sources.employees: all, but web view limited to top 10,000 of ~1.34M records
sources.blocker: Paged search view capped at top 10,000; full data needs account/request; derived from Open Georgia anyway.
sources.notes: Secondary source; not needed given the official bulk files.

private_extra: None found; private universities (Emory, Mercer, etc.) only via IRS 990.
gaps: No department, FTE, hire date, or base vs. supplemental pay split in Open Georgia. No standalone USG or TCSG salary database found. Foundation and athletic-association pay excluded.
notes: Open Georgia covers USG + TCSG + GMC in one statewide file, so no per-institution pages were pursued. Header verified via a 40 KB range request (no full download). Did not check AJC salary database (no confirmed downloadable data).
